modules.title: SOC and Incident Response Orientation
modules.scope: Incident detection vs investigation vs response
lessons: Security operations roles and escalation
Alerts versus events versus confirmed incidents
CIA impact and business context
SOC L1 responsibilities and boundaries
Writing a fact-based incident ticket
modules.scenario: A suspicious alert comes from an endpoint monitoring console with little context. Decide what is known, unknown and who must be notified.
modules.artifact: One-page SOC triage ticket, glossary of 20 terms and a role-escalation chart

modules.title: Incident Response Frameworks and NIST SP 800-61r3
modules.scope: Preparation; Detect; Respond; Recover; continuous improvement
lessons: IR objectives, roles and authorized scope
NIST SP 800-61r3 and CSF 2.0 alignment
Difference between older linear phases and modern lifecycle
Incident declaration and severity thresholds
Exercise plans and improvement follow-through
modules.scenario: An organization has a malware detection with uncertain customer impact. Create an IR action sequence without assuming a breach.
modules.artifact: IR lifecycle diagram, authority matrix and severity/notification draft

modules.title: MITRE ATT&CK: What It Is and Why Responders Use It
modules.scope: ATT&CK Enterprise, adversary behavior and evidence
lessons: What ATT&CK models and what it does not
Enterprise, Mobile and ICS domain distinctions
How incident responders use behavioral context
Tactics versus techniques versus evidence
Why ATT&CK is not a chronological kill chain
modules.scenario: A brief incident description references unusual PowerShell and account access. Identify behavior without jumping to attribution.
modules.artifact: Plain-language ATT&CK explanation plus 5 evidence-versus-inference examples

modules.title: Tactics, Techniques, Sub-techniques and Procedures
lessons: Identify tactics and their purpose
Locate technique and sub-technique IDs
Separate a technique from a specific procedure
Read mitigations, detection strategies and analytics
Use confidence qualifiers in mappings
modules.scenario: Given a fictional SSH and suspicious command timeline, map two behaviors to possible tactics and document uncertainty.
modules.artifact: Technique mapping worksheet with links, supporting facts and confidence

modules.title: ATT&CK Enterprise v20.1 Navigation and Version Control
lessons: Navigate platform filters and Enterprise matrix
Read the 15-tactic current Enterprise matrix
Understand Stealth and Defense Impairment categories
Find technique versions and deprecated objects
Record mapping date and matrix version
modules.scenario: Compare an archived screenshot using Defense Evasion to the current Enterprise matrix and identify outdated labels.
modules.artifact: Versioned ATT&CK reference sheet and corrected legacy-to-current notes

modules.title: Turn Incident Narratives into ATT&CK Mappings
lessons: Extract observable actions from reports
Identify the relevant platform and tactic
Select a precise supported technique
Distinguish evidence from hypotheses
Write a confidence and alternate-explanation note
modules.scenario: A report shows a user opening a lure, a script running and later connection attempts. Map only what is actually supported.
modules.artifact: Annotated incident narrative with supported, tentative and rejected mappings

modules.title: IR Preparedness: Playbooks, Contacts and Evidence Readiness
lessons: Create a business-aware incident playbook
Identify approval and response authority
Inventory critical hosts and log sources
Define secure evidence storage and case naming
Run a tabletop exercise and capture gaps
modules.scenario: A simulated small company has no agreed-on process for handling a suspected account takeover.
modules.artifact: Playbook v1, contact/approval checklist and tabletop notes

modules.title: SOC Alert Triage, Severity and Escalation
modules.scope: SOC incident workflow and ATT&CK triage
lessons: Triage incoming SIEM/EDR alerts
Validate time zones, hosts and identities
Assess false positives and alert quality
Estimate scope, severity and confidence
Escalate through documented authority
modules.scenario: Given 5 fictional alerts, identify one urgent incident and justify why others need more investigation.
modules.artifact: Five triage tickets, severity rationale and escalation decision log

modules.title: Digital Evidence, Preservation and Chain of Custody
lessons: Identify volatile and persistent evidence
Avoid altering suspect systems unnecessarily
Record acquisition time and system context
Generate and verify cryptographic checksums
Build a basic chain-of-custody record
modules.scenario: A device may have active malware and a pending reboot. Document what evidence is at risk and plan safe preservation.
modules.artifact: Acquisition checklist, hashes, custody ledger and integrity verification note

modules.title: Windows Authentication and Identity Investigation
modules.scope: Authentication patterns and credential access evidence
lessons: Read Windows Event Viewer and filtering
Interpret 4624 and 4625 with context
Correlate 4720-4733 account changes
Recognize password spraying versus user error
Map observed behavior cautiously to ATT&CK
modules.scenario: A synthetic log export contains repeated failed sign-ins followed by a successful remote logon.
modules.artifact: Authentication timeline, host/account scope, ATT&CK map and false-positive analysis

modules.title: Windows Process, PowerShell and Sysmon Telemetry
lessons: Interpret process and parent-child relationships
Understand Sysmon Event 1 context
Investigate script and PowerShell logging
Track suspicious scheduled tasks and services
Create an evidence table for executable behavior
modules.scenario: A fabricated process tree shows an office application launching an unexpected shell.
modules.artifact: Process-tree diagram, ATT&CK mapping, SIEM query sketch and response recommendation

modules.title: Linux and SSH Incident Investigation
lessons: Read SSH and authentication logs across distros
Use journalctl and systemctl read-only
Inspect users, groups and sudo history
Review processes, network sockets and cron indicators
Document volatile data and safe collection
modules.scenario: A Linux server shows many SSH authentication failures followed by a successful connection from an unfamiliar source.
modules.artifact: Linux log timeline, probable scope and safe preservation steps

modules.title: Network Forensics: DNS, HTTP, TLS and PCAP
modules.scope: Network observations, beaconing and exfiltration clues
lessons: Review packet captures safely
Filter DNS and HTTP metadata
Interpret ports, flows and TLS limitations
Identify possible beacon patterns without overclaiming
Correlate network and endpoint evidence
modules.scenario: A sample PCAP shows periodic outbound requests from an endpoint with suspicious process activity.
modules.artifact: Packet evidence table, filtered-flow screenshots and alternative explanation

modules.title: Phishing, Initial Access and User Execution
modules.scope: Phishing, suspicious attachments and initial access
lessons: Recognize phishing evidence and email headers
Trace user-reported click times
Examine URLs and documents without executing them
Determine if payload execution is supported
Recommend mailbox, identity and host response actions
modules.scenario: A fictional employee reports a suspicious email and a subsequent browser redirect.
modules.artifact: Phishing investigation report including evidence, scope, ATT&CK and containment options

modules.title: Credential Access and Compromised Identity
modules.scope: Credentials, anomalous sign-ins and privilege use
lessons: Assess password spraying and account takeover signals
Distinguish credential access from lateral movement
Investigate new sign-in devices and session activity
Consider MFA fatigue and token misuse evidence
Draft least-disruptive identity containment options

modules.artifact: Identity incident timeline, ATT&CK mapping and containment approval request

modules.title: Persistence and Privilege Escalation
lessons: Recognize scheduled tasks and service modifications
Inspect account creation and local administrators
Read autorun and relevant system evidence
Separate privilege escalation from legitimate admin tasks
Define follow-on checks after containing a host
modules.scenario: Investigation data contains a new local account, scheduled task and elevated process activity.
modules.artifact: Persistence checklist, privilege trace and validation steps

modules.title: Stealth and Defense Impairment (Current ATT&CK)
modules.scope: Stealth; Defense Impairment; monitoring blind spots
lessons: Distinguish hiding activity from disabling defense
Read security-agent state changes
Identify logging gaps and tampering indicators
Consider expected admin maintenance
Escalate monitoring impairment rapidly and safely
modules.scenario: A log sequence indicates telemetry stops immediately after a configuration change.
modules.artifact: Defense-impairment investigation, telemetry-gap timeline and remediation plan

modules.title: Discovery and Lateral Movement Investigation
modules.scope: Discovery, remote services and account scope
lessons: Interpret discovery behaviors in endpoint logs
Review RDP/SMB/WinRM evidence
Build source-to-destination host relationships
Separate authorized administration from suspect access
Contain lateral movement while preserving business-critical services

modules.artifact: Host movement graph, evidence-cited timeline and response priorities

modules.title: Collection, C2 and Exfiltration Analysis
lessons: Understand staging, compression and collection evidence
Identify unusual network destinations
Compare periodic activity against baselines
Correlate file, process and network artifacts
Estimate potential exposure without unsupported certainty
modules.scenario: Synthetic proxy and endpoint logs show archive creation and unexplained outbound transfer.
modules.artifact: Exfiltration hypothesis, scope table and next-evidence requirements

modules.title: Ransomware, Impact and Crisis Containment
modules.scope: Impact techniques, ransomware response and recovery
lessons: Recognize impact indicators without detonating malware
Prioritize isolation and evidence preservation
Identify service dependencies and recovery priorities
Coordinate approvals and executive communication
Validate restoration and watch for reinfection
modules.scenario: Fictional file servers become unavailable while backups are being checked.
modules.artifact: Ransomware IR decision log, containment options and safe recovery checklist

modules.title: Forensic Acquisition and Memory Fundamentals
lessons: Compare live and offline acquisition decisions
Understand evidence hashing and metadata
Inspect a provided memory image with Volatility 3
Review processes, command lines and network connections
Describe limitations of missing or incomplete memory
modules.scenario: A pre-provided, harmless training memory image requires process and connection inventory.
modules.artifact: Volatility worksheet, acquisition log and evidence-based findings

modules.title: Timeline Reconstruction and Case Management
lessons: Normalize time zones and clock drift
Correlate host, identity and network events
Distinguish direct observations from analytical conclusions
Create a defensible incident timeline
Produce a repeatable case note structure
modules.scenario: Synthetic multi-source logs disagree on time zone and several records are missing.
modules.artifact: Unified timeline CSV, evidence index, assumptions and gaps register

modules.title: Malware and Suspicious Document Triage
lessons: Triage safely using metadata and known indicators
Review hashes and file types without execution
Inspect static indicators in an isolated environment
Avoid unsafe upload of confidential samples
Recommend containment and deeper specialist analysis
modules.scenario: A suspicious attachment has a mismatched extension and an endpoint alert.
modules.artifact: Static-triage report, evidence chain and next-step recommendations

modules.title: SIEM Searching, Correlation and Case Enrichment
lessons: Normalize fields across security log sources
Filter by host, user, IP and time
Correlate authentication and process signals
Enrich a detection with ATT&CK context
Measure noise and identify investigation priorities
modules.scenario: A public example dataset includes login anomalies and suspicious process events.
modules.artifact: Search-query notes, correlated case record and false-positive summary

modules.title: Detection Engineering and ATT&CK Analytics
modules.scope: Detection strategies, analytics and rule quality
lessons: Form a clear detection hypothesis
Select reliable log data components
Describe analytics, required context and thresholds
Draft a Sigma-like rule for training data
Test positive and negative examples and tune false positives
modules.scenario: Create a detector for unusual account creation coupled with suspicious session behavior.
modules.artifact: Detection spec, sample rule, test results and ATT&CK mapping

modules.title: TTP-Based Threat Hunting
lessons: Contrast hunting and reactive triage
Choose a threat-informed hunt hypothesis
Bound scope by assets and telemetry
Evaluate evidence that supports or refutes the hypothesis
Convert useful findings into new detection ideas
modules.scenario: Hunt for patterns suggesting remote execution in historical training telemetry.
modules.artifact: Hunt plan, queries, results, limitations and recommended detections

modules.title: Data Requirements, Coverage and Blind-Spot Analysis
lessons: Map ATT&CK behaviors to observable evidence
Identify required hosts and data sources
Track absent, delayed and low-quality telemetry
Prioritize coverage based on relevance and risk
Write an actionable logging improvement proposal
modules.scenario: A team has endpoint logs but no DNS records for a suspected outbound connection.
modules.artifact: Coverage matrix, gap register and prioritized collection plan

modules.title: ATT&CK Navigator, SOC Maturity and Reporting
lessons: Create a Navigator layer for an incident
Color supported and suspected technique mappings differently
Avoid treating colored techniques as proof of full detection
Assess SOC people, process and technology capabilities
Summarize coverage strengths and remaining gaps for stakeholders

modules.artifact: Navigator JSON layer, SOC assessment summary and improvement roadmap

modules.title: Containment, Eradication, Recovery and Communications
lessons: Weigh isolation choices against operational risk
Preserve evidence before destructive actions
Plan credential resets, patching and restoration
Communicate situation and uncertainty clearly
Run a lessons-learned review with measurable actions
modules.scenario: A multi-system intrusion requires response choices across IT operations, business continuity and security.
modules.artifact: IR action plan, status updates, recovery tests and retrospective

modules.title: Full ATT&CK-Informed Incident Investigation Capstone
modules.scope: End-to-end incident response and ATT&CK evidence mapping
lessons: Receive incident intake and define authority
Analyze host, sign-in and network evidence
Build a supported ATT&CK behavior timeline
Choose containment, eradication and recovery steps
Deliver analyst report, Navigator layer and executive briefing
